fontFamily.description: CSS font-family list for body text; null = the base.css default stack

codeFontFamily.description: CSS font-family list for code and inline code; null = the base.css default stack

embedFonts.description: true (default): subsets of the vendored BIZ UD fonts named in the stacks are embedded as @font-face data URIs; false: the viewer's installed fonts are used

gutter.description: gap between columns (split and two): em = x body font size; null = 2em. At most 20% of the content width. Generated HTML records the effective value

mermaidLib.description: prerender: diagrams are drawn by mermaid-arch and written as SVG; no library in the file. embed and link (Python releases) are no longer accepted

mermaidVersion.description: the Mermaid version mermaid-arch draws with (null = that version). Another version is an error; generated HTML records the effective version

splitRatio.description: page: text column fraction of its split layout

span.description: two-column pages: 1 = keep the block in a column, 2 = full-width band
